instruction: Turn off desktop animations in the accessibility or interface settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.1);

Expected value 'false\n' matches actual gsettings command output format (includes newline character) - verified against actual command behavior
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the enable-animations setting is false, which fully validates the instruction requirement to 'turn off desktop animations'
No postconfig needed for verification: uses system command (gsettings) rather than UI inspection, so state is persistent and accessible regardless of UI state
